title: Café site: content, accessibility and final acceptance
desc: Child of the café epic. Deliverable: real copy (café name, hours, address, three sections of text), alt text on every inline SVG image, an a11y pass (labels, focus order, contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text, prefers-reduced-motion respected), and the run-through of the epic acceptance checklist. ACCEPTANCE: the README lists how to open the site and what was verified; every checklist item in the parent epic is answered with evidence (command + output) in the PR; anything not verified is reported as not verified. This child owns the final check only if it is the last one finished.
